text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Tell me. What's this about slaying a vampire?
text_block_list.orig_text:
いま……
ヴァンパイアを倒すと言ったか？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong, Illya?
Me and Kaori here are full-fledged vampire hunters right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
イリヤはん、
それがなんでっしゃろか？
うちとカオリはんはいま、
ヴァンパイアハンターなんどす！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Vampire hunters, you say?
text_block_list.orig_text: ヴァンパイアハンターじゃと？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Aye. We caught wind of rumors that a legendary vampire
had been revived. And vampires are mighty terrifying, so someone
had to rise up to the occasion. That was us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうどす。
伝説のヴァンパイアが蘇ったって聞いて、
ヴァンパイアは恐ろしい存在やから、
退治せなあかん思うて、
うちらが立ち上がったんどす。

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
According to those legends, said vampire spread
terror all through Landosol.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かつて、
伝説のヴァンパイアによって、
ランドソルは
恐ろしい目に遭ったという伝承が残ってるんどす。

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
And it'll happen again if we don't do something about it!
I mean, it [i]is[/i] a legendary vampire after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
放っておいたらランドソルが大変なことになるさー！
なんて言ったって、
伝説のヴァンパイアさ～！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
That's why we're here. Vampires are weak to
garlic and wooden stakes, so we went
hunting for something even stronger!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから、私たちは……
ヴァンパイアの弱点である
ニンニクと白木の杭……
よりもすごいものを集めていたさ～！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
I see. And thus you deemed goya veggies and
an udon rolling pin suitable candidates, respectively.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それで、
ニンニクの代わりに『ゴーヤーっぽいもの』、
白木の杭の代わりに『うどん用麺棒』ということか……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Actually, that gives me an idea!
It'd be awesome if you could help us during the actual fight, too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ！　
イリヤも、私たちと一緒に
伝説のヴァンパイアを倒すのを手伝ってほしいさ～！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Heh... Hehehe...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ……
ふふふ……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Ahhhahaha!
No can do, I'm afraid.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああっはっははは！
それは、無理な相談じゃなあ……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: How come?
text_block_list.orig_text: どうしてさ～？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
My furry little friends.
You wouldn't happen to know
that vampire's name, would you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
お主ら……
その伝説のヴァンパイアの名は、
知っておるかのう？

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Not yet, no...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは、
まだどす……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Very well. Allow me the honors, then.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか。
ならば教えてやろう……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Her name was none other than Illya Ornstein!
Shiver and quake in fear!For the legend herself, the vampire that
ruled over Landosol with a reign of terror, stands before you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのヴァンパイアの名は
イリヤ・オーンスタイン！
かつて
ランドソルを恐怖で支配した……
伝説のヴァンパイアじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Illya Ornstein...
Wait, whaaaaaat?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
イリヤ・オーンスタイン……
ええええええええっ！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: You were the legendary vampire all along?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
イリヤが……
イリヤが、伝説のヴァンパイアだったさ～！？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Hah! As if!
There's no way a little kid could be a scary vampire!
text_block_list.orig_text:
って、
そんなわけないさー！
イリヤみたいな小さい子がヴァンパイアのわけないさー

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Ain't heard a joke that good in a li'l while.
Oh. Maybe those rumors all started 'cause
Illya was playin' pretend?
text_block_list.orig_text:
イリヤはんたら冗談がうまいわー
あっ、
もしかしてヴァンパイアの噂も、
イリヤはんのごっこ遊びから生まれたんとちゃう？

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
I'd believe it!
Guess Makoto was just jumping to conclusions!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あり得るさー！　
マコトの早とちりかもねー！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
You dare call me a child?
Insinuate that I like to play pretend?
Know your place!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お主ら、
先ほどから小さいやら、ごっこ遊びやら、
失礼なことばっかり言いおって！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Very well. Allow me to show you terror incarnate.
text_block_list.orig_text: ならば見せてやろう！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
{0}!
Your presence allows me to return to my adult form!
And my magic reserves will skyrocket during that time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}！
お主さえおればわらわは大人になれるのじゃ！
大人の姿になれば魔力もいまより格段に上がる！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Th-that requires hugging you, so be still for me!
choice_data_list: I'm not ready for that sort of action!
Now, now. Let's all calm down.
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いまから抱き着くからのう！　
じっとしておれ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Silence! Quit acting like a child!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えぇい！　
小娘のような言い訳をするでない！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Calm down? Never!
Accept the hug already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
落ち着いていられるか！　
黙って抱き着かれろ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: H-here I go! Hug!
text_block_list.orig_text:
い、
いくぞ！　
それっ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Urgh...
Why does my heart always flutter
so much upon hugging him?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うぅっ……
なぜ{0}に抱き着くと、
こんなにドキドキと心臓が高鳴るのじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... 
M-my body... It's getting all hot...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ……
か、
身体が……
熱いっ……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
What the?!
She's... she's getting bigger!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ひえっ！？　
イリヤが……
どんどん成長していくさー！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
N-no way...
You gotta be kidding me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こ、
こんなことが……
嘘や！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe...
I can feel my power swelling.
My true form has been unleashed anew...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふふっ……
魔力が、満ちてゆくぞ……
これこそ、
わらわのあるべき姿……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Haaahahaha!
Behold! For I am the pinnacle of all lifeforms!
The Ruler of the Night, Illya Ornstein!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はーーーーはっはっはっ！
わらわこそ夜を統べる絶対の頂点！　
伝説のヴァンパイア！
イリヤ・オーンスタインじゃあああああ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: You thought that moniker was a mere joke? Nay!
text_block_list.orig_text:
言ったはずであろう？　
わらわは夜を統べる者だと！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
How could we be so stupid?
I genuinely thought she just made it up...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
小さい子の考える設定かなんかだと思ってたさー！
微笑ましいと思ってた自分がバカだったさー

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
Likewise...
What's more, I thought my prince was just playing along with it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちもや……
その設定に王子はんが、
付き合ってあげてるんやと思ってたわあ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh...
Oh, to be alive. Never would one expect
to be saved by the very people hoping to slay you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっくっく……
まさか、命を助けられたと思うた二人に、
命を狙われておったとは……
なんとも皮肉な話よのう……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Nor to assist them in procuring the tools
required to do so!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかも……
自分を倒す道具を、
一緒に探しておったとは……！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... Ahaha!
What a riot, indeed! But you see, my former furry friends.
I have little intent of accepting my end here.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ……
はーっはっはっはっはっ！
じゃが、
わらわとて黙って殺されるわけにはいかん！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Now then. What say we  get started?
text_block_list.orig_text:
さぁ、
そこの二人、
わらわを倒したいのじゃろう？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
You have your tools.
So come at me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その『ゴーヤーっぽいもの』と、
『魔物の角』でかかってくるが良い！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: Ugh... We ain't got much of a choice here, Kaori...
text_block_list.orig_text:
くっ……
カオリはん……
うちらも
覚悟決めなあきまへん……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Do we... do we really need to do this?!
She's our friend! Our comrade!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなっ……
でも……！
イリヤは……
私たちの仲間でっ……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text:
I feel the same, you know!
Gettin' to know how reliable and knowledgeable
she is for her size really took me by surprise!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うちだって……
うちだってそうどす！
小さなお嬢ちゃんやけど
物知りで、
頼りになる子で……！

text_block_list.name: Maho
text_block_list.text: It honestly feels like we've been best buds forever now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まるで、
ずっと友達やったような気さえしとった……

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text:
Same here!
We worked together, fought together...
So why did it come to this...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私だってそうさー！
一緒に行動して、
一緒に戦って……
なのに……！

text_block_list.name: Kaori
text_block_list.text: Why did the legendary vampire have to be [i]her[/i]?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なのに、
伝説のヴァンパイアだったなんて……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Yet you cannot hide from the truth.
I am your enemy. The vampire feared by the world at large!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうじゃ、
わらわは人々が恐れる伝説のヴァンパイア！
お主らが倒すべき敵なのじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
As for myself.
I should be able to make short work of you two.
I [i]should[/i] be able to do so with ease...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから……
わらわも、お主らなどあっという間に蹴散らして……
一顧だにしないのが本当なのじゃが……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Argh! This is most irritating!
Enough talk... Have at you!
Show me what you're capable of!
choice_data_list: Go back to being a kid for me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ええい、
まどろっこしいわ！
とにかく……
かかってまいれ！
わらわも全力で相手をしよう！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
But we [i]must[/i].
I have no intention of giving up my life!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうもいかぬわ！　
わらわも生きねばならぬからのう！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Now, of all times?
I'd be a fool to do so!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いまさらなにを言うておるのじゃ！　
この状況で戻れるか！

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text:
Step back, {0}.
This is a matter between the three of us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく、
{0}は下がっておれ！
これは……
わらわとこの二人の問題なのじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: With their weapons at the ready, the three of them faced off, preparing to engage in what would undoubtedly be a battle for the ages.
text_block_list.orig_text:
イリヤとマホ、カオリは向かい合い、武器を構える。
3人の戦い、その決戦の火蓋が今まさに切られようとしていた……
